content:
Field
Description
ContextTimeStamp
System time of event creation.
TargetFileName
The resulting file name that was downloaded
SrudbTableName
Name of the table in system resource utilization database from which event data was read.
SrudbTableIdString
Identifier of the table in system resource utilization database from which event data was read.
AppName
FfcFileIdentifier
24-byte concatenation of a filesystem volume's UUID and a file's inode value.
AppBackgroundBytesRead
Bytes read by application while running in background mode.
AppBackgroundBytesWritten
Bytes written by application while running in background mode.
AppBackgroundContextSwitches
Number of context switches by the application while running in background mode.
AppBackgroundCycleTime
Cycle time in seconds while the application was running in background mode.
AppBackgroundNumberOfFlushes
Number of IO flushes by the application while running in background mode.
AppBackgroundNumReadOperations
Number of read operations by the application while running in background mode.
AppBackgroundNumWriteOperations Number of write operations by the application while running in background mode.
AppFaceTime
Application face time in seconds, i.e., application in focus.
AppForegroundBytesRead
Bytes read by application while running in foreground mode.
AppForegroundBytesWritten
Bytes written by application while running in foreground mode.
AppForegroundContextSwitches
Number of context switches by the application while running in foreground mode.
AppForegroundCycleTime
Cycle time in seconds while the application was running in foreground mode.
AppForegroundNumberOfFlushes
Number of IO flushes by the application while running in foreground mode.
AppForegroundNumReadOperations
Number of read operations by the application while running in foreground mode.
AppForegroundNumWriteOperations
Number of write operations by the application while running in foreground mode.
UserSid
The User Security Identifier (UserSID) of the user who executed the command. A UserSID uniquely identifies a user in a
system.
